lensXraySay: Lenzi yeX-ray. Nongedza chero chinhu kuti uone kuti chakagadzirwa sei.
lensMakersSay: Lenzi yevagadziri. Nongedza chero chinhu kuti uone kuti ndiani akachigadzira.
lensFlagSay: Lenzi yemureza. Sarudza chikamu chaunoda kutaura kana kushuvira.
lensesOffSay: Malenzi adzimwa. Hurongwa hunoshanda sezvakajairwa; mipendero inoratidza kuti magirazi achiri pameso.
followingSay: Kutevera {name}: zvese zvavakagadzira zvakatenderedzwa. Dzvanya chero chikamu kuti uone kuti ndiani mumwe akachigadzira.
putOnSay: Uri kuona zvinoona Future Traveler. Nongedza chero chinhu kuti uone kuti chakagadzirwa sei.
holdingSay: Wakamira pa{tag}. Dzvanya Escape kuti urege.
ownerOutside: Kwete kubva kuHAX; akazvigadzira haazivikanwe pano
nothingOnScreen: Hapana chavakagadzira chiri paskrini iyi izvozvi. Vhura mugadzirisi kana rimwe peji uye zvikamu zvavo zvinovheneka.
shotFailedSay: Mufananidzo weskrini hauna kukwanisa kugadzirwa pano, saka nyaya inotakura X-ray snapshot panzvimbo pacho.
shotReadySay: Mufananidzo weskrini wagadzirira. Unoenda kuclipboard yako kana wavhura nyaya, kuti ugone kuuisa.
shotBlockedSay: Browser yako yavharira kukopa mufananidzo. Dzvanya kurudyi pamufananidzo weskrini usarudze Copy image, wobva wauisa munyaya.
shotCopiedSay: Mufananidzo weskrini wakopwa. Munyaya, dzvanya panotaurwa kuti uise, wobva wadzvanya Ctrl+V (Cmd+V paMac).
copyBlockedSay: Kukopa kwavharirwa nebrowser. Sarudza mavara panzvimbo pacho.
flaggedSay: Waisa mureza pa{tag}. Tsanangura zvawakaona kana zvaunoshuvira kuti zviite.
notRegistered: Chikamu ichi hachisi muregistry yeHAX, saka nhoroondo yacho haizivikanwe pano.
agentCommits: Mamwe {commits} akagadzirwa nevamiriri vekodhi, achitungamirwa nevanhu vari pamusoro.
shotFailedCaption: X-ray snapshot, {w} x {h} px. Mufananidzo weskrini hauna kukwanisa kugadzirwa pano.
shotCaption: {w} x {h} px PNG, {kb} KB. Kana kukopa kwavharirwa, dzvanya kurudyi pamufananidzo usarudze Copy image.
lensTranslateSay: Lenzi yekushandura. Chikamu chese chemavara chakakomberedzwa chinogona kuvandudzwa. Baya chimwe.
txPickLangHint: HAX inochinjira kumutauro iwoyo, kuti uone mazwi anoonekwa nevanhu chaizvo. Unogona kuuchinja chero nguva.
txLinkCopied: Link yakopwa. Ani nani anoivhura anowana peji iyi mu{lang}, lenzi yekushandura yakavhurwa.
txKeep: Siya {tokens} sezvazvakanyorwa chaizvo: HAX inoisa kukosha ipapo.
txEmpty: Hapana parizvino. Baya mazwi akakomberedzwa kuti utange.
txOtherNote: Pane chimwe here? (mutauro chero upi, hazvimanikidzwe)
txSendHint: Inovhura mushumo wakagadzirwa kare. Pinda muGitHub wobaya Create. Haufaniri kuchinja chero chinhu mairi.
txCopied: Zvakopwa. Zvinamira muemail kana mumeseji kuchikwata cheHAX.
txLookingAt: {en}, zvino {now}. Baya Enter kuti upe mazwi ari nani.
txLookingMissing: {en}, hazvisati zvashandurwa. Baya Enter kuti uzvishandure.
noChecksFound: Ongororo dzinozviitira dzega hadzina kuwana chinhu pano. Tsanangura chakakuvharira.
alreadyReported: Zvakatoshumwa here? Tanga watarisa, wobva wapa +1 ipapo.
replayHelp: Kudzokorora kunobvumira muchengeti kuvhura izvi pasaiti yekuedza oona dambudziko. Mafaira kubva pasaiti yako anotsiviwa nezvinomiririra.
replayTooBig: Kudzokorora uku kwakakura zvakanyanya kulink. Kudhawunirodhe wokweva faira kuenda kunyaya.
githubAccount: Mishumo inoenda kuGitHub; unoda akaundi yeGitHub.
